_why: round A_2 P2: Create SLURM script writes Working.discovery.chain_job's array job for EVERY pending run (it scripted runs[0] alone). Opening the modal is a dry run per run - nothing is written and no row is marked - so this state leaves the store as it found it: each pending template run is listed with its tasks, partition, null draws and wall, a seed run says it goes from the Seed page, and the first ready run's script is shown with how it comes back

round A_2 P2: a template run sent to the cluster is marked on cluster SERVER-side (it was browser state only, gone on reload); its row names the tasks and the folder to bring back, and offers Import results. Populated once a template run has been exported (Create in the modal); the empty arm is the runs list itself

round A_2 P2: Jobs > Waiting on the cluster lists a template run's chain job from its run row (it listed the old script as 'no return path'): written / partial (tasks back) / returned / importing / imported, read off the task result files, with what to copy (spec, script, channel arrays) and Import results through Discovery's own import

round A_2 P2: an imported chain run is a Discovery run like any other - done, its spans counted, in where each run fires and the scoreboard - and its row says it was computed on the cluster and whether the counts the sweep here wrote agree with the cluster's. Populated once a chain job's return/ folder has been imported

round A_2 P2: an imported chain run reaches the detection map as a local run does (its row is the chain it executed; a cell is detections per covered hour). Populated once a chain job has been imported; the map does not mark where a run computed, by design
